Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.
  • Major course grades At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

Liberty’s transfer rules

  • Up to 45 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 60-credit degree.
  • At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Liberty.

Questions

Does Study.com College Composition I transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com College Composition I for ENGL 101 Composition and Rhetoric (3 semester credits) in the Accounting (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com Public Speaking transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com Public Speaking for COMS 101 Speech Communication (3 semester credits) in the Accounting (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Study.com College Algebra transfer to Liberty University?

Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Study.com College Algebra for MATH 121 College Algebra (3 semester credits) in the Accounting (A.A.), with conditions. Ask Liberty to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Liberty University’s Accounting (A.A.)?

Liberty’s published limit for this 60-credit degree is 45 semester credits from other sources. At least 15 semester credits must be completed at Liberty. This plan proposes 24 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Liberty University?

In this plan, 36 semester credits are taken at Liberty, including RLGN 104 Christian Life and Biblical Worldview, BIBL 104 Survey of Old and New Testament, THEO 104 Introduction to Theology Survey, BUSI 201 Intermediate Business Computer Applications, ACCT 211 Financial Principles and ACCT 212 Managerial Principles and 5 more. Liberty requires at least 15 semester credits at Liberty.

Has Liberty University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Liberty’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school for a written transfer evaluation that confirms these courses for your catalog year, including any major-course residency rules. Ask the school whether your state changes the general-education requirements in this plan. Ask the school to confirm 1 proposed course match for this exact program before paying for it. Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Liberty’s decisions.
